summary: INCOMPLETE. On the exact assigned head, the unchanged r3 prototype reproduced whole-batch replay in parallel multi-shard exhaustion: a completed shard's atomic increment changed from the expected 1 to 6 after the other shard's marked pre-handler rejection exhausted its alternatives. A narrow disposable CloudSolrClient guard was added and rerun at the same seed; the completed shard remained at 1 in both parallel and sequential exhaustion, the rejected shard stayed at 0, the RF=2 alternate-replica success leg applied each increment once, and delete-by-query plus commit succeeded. Client repeatability, async UPDATE no-replay and JDK/Jetty response-close checks passed. This remains an incomplete, non-production probe because the client trusts any marked 503, repeatability is not guaranteed for concurrently mutated materialized requests, production marker packaging was not verified, mixed-version behavior was simulated rather than run against an older Solr, async body/query paths are not comprehensive, and the original in-flight indexing 503 remains unresolved.
